description: A funny but useful roast of one of the user's CVs — blunt feedback on what a recruiter would laugh at. Daily limit: free 1, PRO 3. Use when the user asks for brutally honest feedback or a roast. Returns {session, usage} or 429 quota_exceeded.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.
